title: Strict henselization preserves regular local rings
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local commutative ring and $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ its strict henselization with respect to a separable closure of its residue field. Then $R$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] if and only if $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ is a regular local ring.
